conflicts.description: The Wardens hoard repair knowledge, the Storm Singers refuse to intervene, and the Wanderers' pleas are ignored while the archipelago drifts apart.
conflicts.name: The Failing Bridges

conflicts.description: The Guild's maps prove the decay is accelerating, but its neutrality and low standing leave it unable to compel the other factions to act.
conflicts.name: The Cartographers' Warning

description: Aerelon is a fractured realm of floating islands held together by ancient skybridges, spans of woven starlight and living stone that bind the enclaves into a single, fragile archipelago. This is a wondrous fantasy for young adult readers, full of luminous winds, cloud-seas and impossible vistas. The skybridges are now failing, one fading strand at a time, and the rival enclaves distrust one another too deeply to notice that the archipelago is slowly drifting apart. A young cartographer, whose maps reveal the pattern of the decay, must carry that knowledge across the gulfs and persuade the islands to unite before the realm is scattered to the open sky.

factions.description: Mapmakers who track the position of every island and skybridge, sworn to neutrality but short on influence.
factions.name: Cartographers' Guild

factions.description: Bridge-smiths who hold the secrets of skybridge anchor maintenance and demand tribute for repairs.
factions.name: Ironroot Wardens

factions.description: Mystics of the Spires who believe the failing bridges are a natural cycle and resist human intervention.
factions.name: Storm Singers

factions.description: Displaced islanders and smugglers of the Hollow Drift who ferry goods by glider and resent the older enclaves' neglect.
factions.name: Drift Wanderers

history.description: The ancestors of the enclaves wove the first skybridges to join the newly risen islands.
history.name: The First Weaving

history.description: The enclaves agreed to share bridge upkeep and open passage for all.
history.name: The Lantern Accord

history.description: A central skybridge collapsed, splitting the Hollow Drift and exposing the Accord's neglect.
history.name: The Fall of the Hollow Span

history.description: Ironroot Hold began charging tribute for anchor repairs, breaking the spirit of the Accord.
history.name: The Tribute Edict

locations.description: A terraced island city lit by glowing moss lanterns, home to the Cartographers' Guild and the central skybridge anchor that links all other enclaves.
locations.name: Lantern Reach

locations.description: A rugged island of giant metallic-barked trees whose roots dangle below the stone. Its artisans maintain the skybridge anchors, and they guard their craft jealously.
locations.name: Ironroot Hold

locations.description: A cluster of needle-thin peaks wrapped in perpetual wind. Storm-singers live here and read the air currents that shift the islands' positions.
locations.name: Mistral Spires

locations.description: A half-shattered island at the edge of the archipelago, split by a collapsed skybridge. Refugees and smugglers shelter among its broken arches.
locations.name: The Hollow Drift

name: The Drifting Archipelago of Aerelon

rules.statement: Every skybridge must be anchored at both ends by a resonance stone; if one anchor dims, the span slowly unravels.
Islands float because of lifting crystals in their cores, and drift according to the pull of surrounding crystal fields.
Skybridges can only be repaired by weaving starlight at night, using songs taught across enclaves.
No enclave may close a skybridge to another without a vote of the Lantern Accord, an unwritten custom now widely ignored.
Travel off the skybridges relies on wind-gliders of silk and bone, since no engine or explosive power functions reliably in the aether-rich air.
